title: 第25章 搁这海选呢第26章 谁不知道土木行业最是锻炼人
slug: 西游平账大圣在我贪亿点咋了
content_zh:
三百里外，无名山谷。
太白金星与许旌阳真人按照苏元的吩咐，已在山谷外围布下了潜踪匿迹、隔绝探查的阵法。
许旌阳真人手中维持着阵法运转的法诀，脸上不禁流露出担忧之色。
他侧头对身边的太白金星低声道：
“金星，就让我二人在此辛苦维持阵法，却让小苏独自一人进去与那六个积年的妖王谈判……是否太过行险？万一谈崩了，动起手来……”
太白金星正全神贯注地调整着一处阵眼，闻言没好气地白了许旌阳一眼：
“废话！
你以为老夫不想回飞舟上喝着仙茶、听着仙乐，舒舒服服地休息？”
“但你敢让苏元那小子来布这‘两仪微尘匿踪阵’吗？嗯？你觉得他会么？”
他顿了顿，恨铁不成钢地骂道：
“那小子，一身本事全特么长在心眼子和嘴皮子上了！
除了几手保命的遁术，你见他正儿八经掐过一个像样的诀？布过一个完整的阵？”
许旌阳真人闻言，也是哑然失笑，摇了摇头：
“唉，说的也是。
回想起来，确实从未见小苏施展过什么精妙法术。
也不知这孩子究竟是怎么一路修炼到这境界的，真是个异数。”
太白金星笑道：
“不过话说回来，老夫倒是对他颇有信心。
况且，”
他话锋一转，自嘲道，

“天庭此次给出的‘赏格’可是丰厚得连我都有些心动，何况那些下界泥腿子妖王？”
正说话间，一道金光掠过，
孙悟空拽着苏元的胳膊，直直停在太白金星面前。
“嘿嘿，太白老倌儿，许天师，又见面了！”
悟空笑嘻嘻地打招呼，显得兴致勃勃。
太白金星与许旌阳连忙拱手：
“大圣爷，别来无恙，风采更胜往昔啊！”
苏元迅速从储物法宝里掏出四套黑市同款的宽大黑袍，
一件自己利索地披上，兜帽拉低遮住面容，剩下的分给众人：
“大圣，别唠了，快穿上，莫要露了行藏。”
接着，他又取出一摞黑袍，走到谷口显眼处，将它们整整齐齐地叠在石头上，
旁边还用法力悬浮着一行小字：“自取，勿喧哗。”
做完这一切，苏元回到山谷中央一块大石上坐下，
眼观鼻，鼻观心，如同老僧入定，静待“有缘妖”
孙悟空披着黑袍，但哪里静得下来，坐在一旁抓耳挠腮，嘀嘀咕咕：
“没用的，小苏。
我那些兄弟我最了解，各个都是铁骨铮铮的好汉子，重义气！
我看你注定要白忙活。”
content_en:
Three hundred miles away, there is an unknown valley.
Following Su Yuan's instructions, Taibai Jinxing and Xu Jingyang had set up formations around the valley to hide and isolate them from exploration.
Master Xu Jingyang held the magic formula to maintain the operation of the formation, and he couldn't help but show worry on his face.
He turned his head and whispered to Taibai Jinxing beside him:
"Jinxing, let the two of us work hard to maintain the formation here, but let Xiao Su go in alone to negotiate with the six-year-old demon king... Is it too risky? If the negotiation breaks down, take action..."
Taibai Jinxing was concentrating on adjusting one of his formations. When he heard this, he rolled his eyes at Xu Jingyang angrily:
"Nonsense!
Do you think I don’t want to go back to the flying boat to drink fairy tea, listen to fairy music, and rest comfortably? "
"But do you dare to let that boy Su Yuan set up this 'Liangyi Mote Concealment Formation'? Hmm? Do you think he can?"
He paused and cursed:
"That boy, all his abilities are based on his cleverness and words!
Apart from a few life-saving escape techniques, have you ever seen him perform a decent trick? Set up a complete formation? "
When Master Xu Jingyang heard this, he also laughed dumbly and shook his head:
"Oh, that's true.
Looking back, I have never seen Xiao Su perform any subtle spells.
I don’t know how this child cultivated all the way to this level. He is really an anomaly. "
Taibai Jinxing smiled and said:
“But having said that, I have quite a lot of confidence in him.
Besides,"
He changed the topic and laughed at himself,
"The 'reward' given by Heaven this time is so generous that even I am a little moved, not to mention those mud-legged demon kings from the lower world?"
While he was talking, a golden light passed by,
Sun Wukong grabbed Su Yuan's arm and stopped directly in front of Taibai Jinxing.
"Hey, Taibai old man, Xu Tianshi, we meet again!"
Goku said hello with a smile, appearing to be in high spirits.
Taibai Jinxing and Xu Jingyang quickly handed over their hands:
"Great Sage, you are well and you are looking even better than before!"
Su Yuan quickly took out four sets of large black robes of the same style on the black market from his storage magic weapon.
He put on one piece neatly, pulled down his hood to cover his face, and distributed the rest to everyone:
"Great Sage, stop nagging and put it on quickly. Don't expose your hidden clothes."
Then, he took out a pile of black robes, walked to a conspicuous place at the mouth of the valley, and neatly folded them on the stone.
There is also a line of small words floating next to it with magic power: "Get it yourself, don't make any noise."
After doing all this, Su Yuan returned to the center of the valley and sat down on a big rock.
Look at your nose with your eyes, and look at your heart with your nose, just like an old monk entering meditation, waiting for the "destined demon"
Sun Wukong was wearing a black robe, but he couldn't be quiet. He sat aside scratching his ears and cheeks, muttering:
"It's useless, Xiao Su.
I know my brothers best, all of them are strong-willed and good-hearted men who value loyalty!
I see you are destined to work in vain. "
